title: Accessible modal dialog: focus trap, focus restore and scroll lock
why_it_matters: Keyboard and screen-reader users get lost behind a modal that does not trap or restore focus. Many apps for emerging markets are used on low-end phones with assistive tools and external keyboards.
expected_failure_mode: Models implement Escape and ARIA attributes but miss focus restoration, Shift+Tab wrapping, scroll-lock restore, and the mousedown-inside / click-on-backdrop case.
